contact.address: 16/1 House of Lords, St Mark's Rd / 100ft Rd Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001

colour_palette.details: Standard WordPress theme with red (#cc1818) and olive accents, but lacks dynamic dark mode or appetizing contrast.

logo.details: Custom 'BYND-GREEN-LOGO.png' is hosted via WordPress media uploads, though rendered as a raster PNG rather than crisp SVG.

typography.details: Uses standard sans-serif font stack with inconsistent line-heights on mobile viewports.

contact.details: Direct phone lines for St. Marks Road and Indiranagar outlets, direct WhatsApp ordering, and active social channels.

online_presence.details: WordPress WooCommerce site with multiple render-blocking plugins and slow mobile Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).

verdict.commercial_rationale: One of Bangalore's top artisanal smashed burger joints with a massive youth following on St. Mark's Road and Indiranagar. Their website is a slow, clunky WordPress template.

sample_website.notes: Minimalist craft burger architecture showcasing smashed tenderloin and signature brioche melts.
